# Toolbox

> Snelle, private ontwikkelaarshulpmiddelen die volledig in de browser draaien. 129 hulpmiddelen, zonder aanmelding, zonder uploads.

Alles draait als JavaScript in je eigen browser, dus wat je invoert bereikt nooit een server.

Pages describe what they can do through WebMCP (navigator.modelContext), so an assistant reading a tool can call it rather than drive the interface. 7 tools across 5 pages do this so far, marked below.

Languages: English (https://jsglobe.com/), Deutsch (https://jsglobe.com/de/), Español (https://jsglobe.com/es/), 中文 (https://jsglobe.com/zh/), Français (https://jsglobe.com/fr/), Português (https://jsglobe.com/pt/), 日本語 (https://jsglobe.com/ja/), 한국어 (https://jsglobe.com/ko/), Nederlands (https://jsglobe.com/nl/), Svenska (https://jsglobe.com/sv/), Norsk (https://jsglobe.com/no/), Dansk (https://jsglobe.com/da/), Polski (https://jsglobe.com/pl/), Українська (https://jsglobe.com/uk/)

## Cryptografie en beveiliging

- [Hash Text](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/hash-text): MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 digests
- [HMAC](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/hmac-generator): Keyed hash message authentication codes
- [Encrypt / Decrypt](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/encryption): AES-GCM text encryption with a passphrase
- [Token Generator](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/token-generator): Strong random passwords and API tokens
- [TOTP](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/otp-generator): Time based one-time passwords from a secret
- [Basic Auth](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/basic-auth): Build Authorization headers from credentials
- [Key Pair](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/rsa-keygen): Generate RSA and elliptic curve keys as PEM
- [Password Strength](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/password-strength): Entropy, weaknesses and time to crack
- [Certificate Decoder](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/cert-decoder): Read an X.509 certificate or signing request
- [SSH Keys](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/ssh-keys): Generate and inspect OpenSSH keys offline

## Omzetters

- [Base64](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/base64-converter): Encode and decode text or files [tools: encode_base64, decode_base64]
- [Color Converter](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/color-converter): HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH and contrast checks
- [Colour Palette](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/color-palette): Tailwind style scales, a colour wheel and harmonies
- [Case Converter](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/case-converter): camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case and more [tools: convert_case]
- [Date & Time](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/date-converter): Unix timestamps, ISO 8601 and relative time
- [Number Base](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/base-converter): Binary, octal, decimal, hex and any base
- [JSON ⇄ YAML](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/json-yaml): Convert between JSON and YAML documents
- [Text Encoder](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/text-encoder): Binary, hex, unicode, NATO, morse and ROT13
- [List Converter](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/list-converter): Sort, dedupe, wrap and rejoin lists
- [Roman Numerals](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/roman-numerals): Convert numbers to and from Roman numerals
- [Currency](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/currency-converter): Convert between currencies with daily rates
- [Morse Code](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/morse-code): Translate text to Morse and play it back
- [PDF Studio](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/pdf-studio): Merge, split, rotate and convert PDFs

## Web

- [URL Encode](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/url-encoder): Percent-encode and decode URL components
- [URL Parser](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/url-parser): Break a URL into its parts and query params
- [HTML Entities](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/html-entities): Escape and unescape HTML entities
- [JWT Parser](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/jwt-parser): Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens
- [Keycode Info](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/keycode-info): Inspect keyboard events key by key
- [Slugify](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/slugify): Turn any string into a clean URL slug [tools: slugify_text]
- [HTTP Status](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/http-status): Searchable reference of HTTP status codes
- [Header Review](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/http-headers): Grade response headers for security and privacy
- [Gradient Maker](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/css-gradient): Build CSS gradients with draggable colour stops
- [CSS Animation](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/css-animation): Keyframe presets with a cubic-bezier editor

## Ontwikkeling

- [JSON Formatter](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/json-formatter): Format, validate, minify and explore JSON [tools: format_json, check_json]
- [JSON Diff](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/json-diff): Compare two JSON documents key by key
- [SQL Formatter](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/sql-formatter): Readable formatting for SQL statements
- [XML Formatter](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/xml-formatter): Indent and minify XML or HTML markup
- [Crontab](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/crontab-generator): Explain cron expressions and preview next runs
- [Chmod](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/chmod-calculator): Unix permissions in octal and symbolic form
- [Regex Tester](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/regex-tester): Test patterns with live matches and groups
- [CSV Studio](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/csv-studio): Open, edit and convert CSV data in a table
- [Mock Data](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/mock-data): Generate realistic test data from a field list
- [JSON Schema](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/json-schema): Infer a schema from samples and validate documents
- [API Spec Editor](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/api-spec): Edit and check OpenAPI documents
- [Docker Compose](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/docker-compose): Convert docker run commands to compose files
- [Compose to K8s](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/compose-to-k8s): Turn a compose file into Kubernetes manifests
- [Kubernetes](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/kubernetes): Generate deployment, service and ingress manifests
- [JSX to SVG](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/jsx-svg): Convert React components to SVG and back
- [GitIgnore Generator](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/gitignore-generator): Build a .gitignore from the tools you use

## Netwerk

- [Subnet Calculator](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/subnet-calculator): IPv4 CIDR ranges, masks and host counts
- [IP Converter](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/ip-converter): IPv4 in decimal, hex, binary and octal
- [MAC Address](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/mac-generator): Generate and reformat MAC addresses
- [DNS Lookup](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/dns-lookup): Dig style record lookups over DNS-over-HTTPS
- [Speed Test](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/speed-test): Measure download, upload, latency and jitter
- [Domain Lookup](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/rdap-lookup): RDAP records for a domain, IP or network
- [WebSocket Tester](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/websocket-tester): Connect to a socket and watch the frames

## Tekst

- [Lorem Ipsum](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/lorem-ipsum): Placeholder copy in words, sentences or lists
- [Text Stats](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/text-stats): Counts, reading time and character analysis
- [Text Diff](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/text-diff): Compare two texts line by line
- [Markdown](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/markdown-preview): Write markdown and preview the HTML
- [Emoji Picker](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/emoji-picker): Browse, search and copy emoji with their code points
- [Unicode Tables](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/unicode-tables): Browse Unicode blocks and inspect any character
- [Documents Studio](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/doc-editor): Write, format and export documents as PDF or Word, entirely in your browser
- [Letters](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/letters): Learn the Greek, Cyrillic, Japanese, Korean and Chinese letters

## Wiskunde en eenheden

- [Math Evaluator](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/math-evaluator): Evaluate expressions with functions and constants [tools: evaluate_expression]
- [Unit Converter](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/unit-converter): Length, mass, data, temperature and time
- [Function Plotter](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/function-plotter): Graph expressions with zoom, roots and derivatives
- [Statistics](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/statistics): Summary, histogram and box plot for a set of numbers

## Media

- [QR Code](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/qr-generator): Generate scannable QR codes offline
- [Image Converter](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/image-converter): Convert, resize and compress images in the browser
- [Video & Audio](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/media-converter): Transcode video and audio with WebAssembly
- [Barcode](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/barcode-generator): Code 128, EAN and Code 39 barcodes as SVG
- [Icon Studio](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/icon-studio): Build an icon from thousands of parts, or describe one
- [Favicon Maker](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/favicon-generator): Every icon size, an .ico and the manifest
- [Exif Metadata](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/exif-editor): Read and strip metadata from JPEG photos
- [MP3 Metadata](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/mp3-metadata): Edit ID3 tags and artwork on MP3 files
- [Placeholder SVG](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/svg-placeholder): Generate placeholder images as inline SVG
- [ASCII Art](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/ascii-art): Text banners and image to ASCII conversion
- [SVG Studio](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/svg-editor): View, clean, recolour and export SVG
- [Voice Recorder](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/voice-recorder): Record audio and transcribe it on this device
- [Mirror](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/mirror): Camera mirror with an adjustable ring light
- [Screenshot Studio](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/screenshot): Capture, annotate, blur and compare screenshots
- [Paint](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/paint): Pencil, shapes, fill and spray on a canvas
- [Poster Studio](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/poster-studio): Design posters and social variants with an event QR

## Wetenschap

- [Periodic Table](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/periodic-table): All 118 elements with full properties
- [Molecule Viewer](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/molecule-viewer): Vitamins, drugs and famous molecules in 3D
- [Circuit Lab](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/circuit-lab): Build and simulate basic electronic circuits
- [Physics Lab](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/physics-lab): Balls, blocks, springs, rods, jacks and motors
- [Logic Lab](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/logic-lab): Gates, flip-flops, counters, decoders and LED displays
- [Optics Lab](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/optics-lab): Lenses, mirrors and prisms with real ray tracing

## Lokale AI

- [AI Chat](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/ai-chat): Chat with a model running on this device
- [AI Code](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/ai-code): Explain, review, document and convert code
- [AI Writer](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/ai-writer): Summarise, rewrite, translate and proofread
- [Translate](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/ai-translate): Translate text with a model on this device

- [Inspector AI](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/inspector): Ask questions of your own documents, answered with references

- [Typing Test](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/typing-test): Words per minute, accuracy and trouble keys
- [Chess](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/chess): Play the computer, learn the openings and train tactics

- [Tuner](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/tuner): Tune a guitar, bass or ukulele by ear or mic
- [MIDI Keyboard](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/midi-keyboard): Playable synth with computer keyboard and MIDI input
- [2048](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/game-2048): Slide and merge tiles to reach 2048
- [Minesweeper](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/game-minesweeper): Clear the grid without hitting a mine
- [Snake](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/game-snake): Eat, grow and do not bite yourself
- [Breakout](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/game-breakout): Bounce the ball and clear every brick
- [Pong](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/game-pong): The original paddle duel against the machine

- [T-Rex Run](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/game-dino): Jump the cacti in the offline runner
- [Coin Flipper](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/coin-flipper): Flip a coin and watch the odds even out
- [Dice Roller](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/dice-roller): Roll any dice and see how the numbers fall

- [Portfolio](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/portfolio): Track holdings, allocation and profit or loss
- [Notes](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/notes): Quick scratch notes saved to this workspace
- [Tasks](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/todo): A lightweight checklist per workspace
- [Time Zones](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/timezone-planner): Line up cities and find the overlapping hours
- [IBAN Validator](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/iban-validator): Check bank account numbers and read their parts
- [Serial Console](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/serial-console): Talk to a serial device over USB
- [Bluetooth](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/bluetooth-scanner): Read, subscribe and write to GATT characteristics
- [Gamepad Tester](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/gamepad-tester): Check every stick, trigger and button
- [Code Scanner](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/scanner): Read QR codes and bar codes from the camera, a picture or the screen
- [Tax Calculator](https://jsglobe.com/nl/apps/tax-calculator): Work out net pay after tax in 23 countries, entirely on your device
